description: This file defines the AuthenticatorAppController class, which manages two-factor authentication via authenticator apps in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes actions for enabling, verifying, resetting, and generating QR codes for authenticator apps.

classes.name: AuthenticatorAppController
classes.description: Controller managing authenticator app two-factor authentication, including setup, verification, and reset functionalities.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Displays the authenticator app setup page with shared key and QR code.

methods.name: Index (POST)
methods.description: Verifies the authenticator code and enables two-factor authentication.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Displays the reset authenticator app page.

methods.name: ResetPost
methods.description: Resets the authenticator app key and disables two-factor authentication.

methods.name: LoadSharedKeyAndQrCodeUriAsync
methods.description: Loads or generates the shared key and QR code URI for the authenticator app setup.

methods.name: GetUserDisplayNameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the user's display name, email or username based on settings.

methods.name: FormatKey
methods.description: Formats the authenticator key into groups for display.

methods.name: GenerateQrCodeUriAsync
methods.description: Generates the otpauth URI for QR code generation.
